structured_output.what_is_happening: "Leaf" is a coin created straight on PumpSwap. It has no launchpad, was never migrated, and the dev supplied the liquidity (LP), 100% unlocked. At 13 minutes old it rose about 83–102% with $194k volume on a ~$20k market cap. That is about 2,160 buys against 374 sells, and about 1,804 unique buyers against only 53 sellers. At least 9 other "Leaf" tokens were deployed within the same ~7 minutes. Several of them already show liquidity near $0 (0.02, 8.64, 4.73, 1.15 USD), which looks like LP pulls after heavy volume. This looks like a clone or rug farm around a "Leaf" trend (an X handle, Leafdotfun_, is referenced).

narrative.description: A generic 'Leaf' ticker probably tied to some outside event or account (Leafdotfun_). Many copycat deployers are racing on the same name.
narrative.why_spreading: Some outside trigger around 'Leaf' set off a swarm of same-name launches. Volume is split across clones, and none of them is clearly the canonical one.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is one of the earlier deploys (04:06) and currently has the deepest remaining liquidity among the fresh clones. Nothing marks it as official.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 9 same-name Leaf tokens were created within minutes. EKXP7 has $426k h1 volume and $16.7k liquidity. A1dBw is at $225k mcap. Several others are already drained to near-zero liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: Buyers outnumber sellers about 1,804 to 53, which fits bot or airdrop-style buying. GMGN counts 39 bundler wallets holding about 21.8%, and there is a 44-wallet insider trade network. The creator added the LP directly and it is 100% unlocked. Sibling clones with the same pattern have already had their liquidity pulled.
